title: The Rock Shop
content: (Sorry for the repost mods! I wanted to add a photo I took this evening which is the whole reason for the post!) I think I mentioned in a previous post that I've been having this dream since I was a kid -- at the time, the scenes mostly stuck inside the actual mall. One of the earliest, recurring stores I remember was this totally glass storefront, which was completely covered in strobe lights, swirling patterns, colorful strings of Christmas bulbs and neon loops. The kid of thing that turns a kid into a moth so he can go fog up the windows and marvel. It was dope. For maybe a decade it was like an anchor store of the dream -- sometimes when I saw it, I became lucid. In a way, I guess it was almost like a totem -- except in reverse? Anyway, I had a slam-on-the-fucking-breaks moment when we moved back to the town I grew up in recently. I saw the store above, which is a few blocks from my new house and in the same shopping plaza as my grocery store, and immediately recognized it. It was the weird, sparkly, shiny store that basically was the jumping off point into lucid dreaming, and would become this 30 year long narrative in my head that's with me constantly when I sleep. Right there in the Jewel parking lot! Look -- I've spent most of my adult life -- having this dream at least weekly -- pretty convinced that the dream is an intricate construction of my subconscious aided by an overactive imagination and a crippling case of ADHD. It's still the best explanation I've got. Then again, it's not lost on me that it's a fucking crystal shop.
